brand_notes: Reserve series sits below Legend; Pinnacle ring radiator + Turbine Cone drivers + X-Port. Polk rates 8/6/4 Ω amp compatibility with explicit minimum (3.6 Ω R100, 3.8 Ω R200) and no nominal. Polk US page shows reserve prices discounted from list ($559 vs $699 R100). Sources: mfr-polk-audio-reserve-r100, mfr-polk-audio-reserve-r200. Signature Elite ES15 ($299, 8 Ω compatible) has no Tier A/B data.
takeaways: Klippel LW ±1.0 dB (excellent) but f3 67 Hz vs claimed 58 Hz
Measured min 3.6 Ω @ ~250 Hz: flagged effectively-4ohm; Polk gives no nominal
THD ~8% at 96 dB near 110 Hz (graph-read), heavy LF compression at 102 dB
Ring tweeter beams above 5 kHz; Erin found treble prominent at high volume
conflicts: Claimed -3 dB 58 Hz vs measured f3 67 Hz
Nominal impedance not rated by maker; forum owner calls it 4 ohm
